caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a church, viewed from the back and slightly above. The space features several rows of light brown wooden pews arranged in two main blocks with a central aisle and a side aisle to the right. Each pew has hymnals or books in a holder on the backrest, with a white sign displaying attendance information placed on the end of the first left pew. In the back left corner stands a decorated wooden altar area with a brown wooden railing separating it from the seating area. On the altar, there are two ornate wooden chairs with red upholstery, a small wooden table, a Bible or book, and several green potted plants or bouquets of pink and purple flowers arranged in vases. Behind the altar, a large stained-glass window in shades of blue, green, yellow, and white shows an angel with two children, with the words "IN MEMORIUM LUKE 18:16" at the top. To the right, a wooden organ beside the wall has sheet music and an open drawer, with a large vase of flowers standing next to it. Above, three hanging oil lamps with red glass shades are suspended by chains from the ceiling, and a metal stove pipe runs vertically from the bottom center of the drawing. The floor is covered with green patterned carpet, bordered by a design in pale yellow and brown. The right wall shows two tall stained-glass windows with geometric designs in red, green, and blue, and parts of buildings and trees are visible outside. An American flag hangs from a brass pole next to a wall-mounted hymn board displaying numbers. The walls are cream-colored, with ornate white crown molding near the ceiling and decorative trim above the windows. The overall color palette includes browns, greens, reds, and creams, with accents of gold and purple.
title: Baptist Church, 1901
